responding_to.type: bus passengers trapped by rising water

output.english: This is a practice flood alert for Richmond, VA. Flood water is rising in Shockoe Bottom and Riverside Apartments, with fires and downed power lines at Downtown Junction, East Junction, and Broad and 3rd. Stay away from Dock St and Lee Bridge, and get to high ground away from water.
output.spanish: Este es un alerta de práctica por inundación para Richmond, VA. El agua está subiendo en Shockoe Bottom y Riverside Apartments, con incendios y cables caídos en Downtown Junction, East Junction y Broad and 3rd. Aléjese de Dock St y Lee Bridge y vaya a un lugar alto lejos del agua.
